note: Ships §6.123 option (a): reviewable seal files folded at dogfood_store --rebuild.

decisions.question: How may a human seal on a dogfood decision appear in git?
decisions.commitment: As reviewable JSON only: docs/dogfood/seals/<pair_id>.json carrying pair_id, verifier, sealed_at, and seal_sig; verified at rebuild against docs/dogfood/verifiers.json (public ed25519 keys). dogfood_store.py --rebuild folds seal files into the committed store; --verify admits a sealed row only when it traces to such a file. Operators export with scripts/dogfood_seal_export.py after sealing in a review copy or household store.
decisions.why: The one-directional rule stays: no opaque sealed binary in git. Seal files are the same shape as decision files — separate files, regenerated store, diffable signatures. Household ~/.nestor remains the live trust root; this path is for seals worth recording in the repository itself.
